name: [QOL!] Survive Homelander
desc:
Survive Homelander — and other threats lurking in Vought Tower. One player becomes the unstoppable supe, and everyone else must hide, run, record, and survive until time runs out.

Use phones, teamwork, and whatever you can find to stay alive. If you become the threat, hunt them down before they escape your wrath.

Can you survive the most powerful man alive?

🔄 Updates are frequent — stay tuned!
🎟️ Join the group to redeem codes!
